description: Shared-rule candidates found while authoring effects.logic.json: logic repeated verbatim across many effect blocks (inlined there for now). Same shape as a data/logic_rules.json entry; the integrator merges them and the mapping can then reference them with {"rule": [id, params]}.

entries.name: Cast — declared target within reach (Aura ∀ reaches the view)
entries.description: Standard targeting gate of every target-scope effect (used by ~25 blocks as prerequisite `target_in_reach`): either no target was declared (the engine picks the enemy the cast hurts most within range, Rule 15 pc override) or the right-clicked target is within `range` hexes; a cast flagged `aura` (through an Aura ∀) reaches everything within 10.

entries.name: Cast — declared target is an enemy, or none declared
entries.description: Second half of the standard target gate (prerequisite `target_is_enemy` in every damaging / locking block): a right-clicked target must be an enemy (is_enemy); without a declared target the engine aims at an enemy itself.

entries.name: Rule 20 — total dice a point-buy cast rolls
entries.description: Σ over the cast elements of point_buy_dice_count(caster stat behind the element). Used as effect `point_buy_dice` by every point-buy damage block (Harm, Mind Blast, Drain, Meteor Shower, Blizzard, Ice Blast, Dark Matter) and by the stat-penalty blocks. Iterates: pass caster / elements as {"root": ...}.

entries.name: Rule 20 (pc) — damage of a point-buy cast
entries.description: Σ of the kept dice (one per element, highest die of each successful roll, nulls count 0) ÷10 rounded half up. Used as effect `point_buy_damage` by the seven point-buy damage blocks; the peer subtracts a Force Shield from the Σ before rounding.

entries.name: Rule 23 — actions lost by a lock (doubled on ∀)
entries.description: n actions lost by the hit target, doubled when the cast is a ∀ double cast (Lightning, Space-bending). Effect `actions_lost`.

entries.name: Lock — remaining actions of this turn (+ next turn)
entries.description: Actions a target loses from a rest-of-turn lock: its actions_per_round minus the actions already played (action_index + 1), floored at 0; with next_turn (Oblivion) the whole next turn is added. Used by Fossilization and Oblivion.

entries.name: Rule 24 — power of a unit's token behind an element
entries.description: The highest value among a unit's tokens whose elem matches (null when none). Used as the `power` argument of using_rule_24 in the `destroyed_by_rule_24` effect of every point-buy permanent (Oblivion, Inner Fire, Invisibility, Haste, Aura, Disable, Potion brew, Artifice, …). Iterates: pass the element as {"root": ...}.
entries.notes: `unit` here is the unit's tokens array (unit.tokens); the integrator may prefer the whole unit and {"var": "tokens"} inside.

entries.name: Stat buy — stat banked at emission k
entries.description: The caster stat behind the card element going out at emission `step` (1-based), card elements round-robin: element index = (step − 1) mod |elements|. Used as effect `stat_buy_bank_this_emission` by the eight stat-buy blocks (Summoning, 3 Golems, 3 Elementals, Resurrect).
entries.notes: The inlined form reads the element list from the battle context ({"var": "elements"}) via a computed var path; as a named rule the element pick should take the list through the param instead (json-logic has no index-by-expression op, so the integrator may want a small `nth(array, i)` custom op).

entries.name: Rule 23 — ×2 on a ∀ double cast
entries.description: 2 when `every` (two copies chained), else 1. Multiplies locks and the paper's 'power 20 × number of casts' of traps / Creation / Traps mastery.

entries.name: Effect validation — cost keeps its key element
entries.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries the given element (the element family that defines the effect). Used as validation `cost_keeps_key_element` in all 66 blocks.

entries.name: Effect validation — element count within ±1 of canonical
entries.description: |proposal cost| differs from |canonical cost| by at most one. Used as validation `cost_count_within_one` in 59 blocks (the summon families assert the fixed stat_buy_total instead).

entries.name: Effect validation — effect_types keeps a tag
entries.description: The proposal's effect_types still includes the given tag (damage / instant / permanent / stat_buy / channeling / trap / relocate / scout). Used as validation `keeps_type_<tag>` in all 66 blocks.
